summary: Agomab Therapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of full-year 2025 financial results and 2026 outlook, plus materials for an annual general meeting scheduled for May 26, 2026. The filing reports cash of €116.5M and $208M gross IPO proceeds extending runway into H1 2029, clinical milestones for ontunisertib and AGMB-447, and ordinary meeting logistics. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings and meeting notice, not a special situation.
